title: security: enforce RBACv2 KMS region pinning + audit logging hardening
description:
Motivation: Customers in regulated environments require deterministic KMS residency for keys used with private deployments and RBAC v2 policies. This PR enforces KMS region pinning at policy-evaluation time, adds comprehensive audit logging for KMS decisions, and provides operator migration notes. Changes introduce a policy-level constraint that prevents granting access to KMS keys outside an allowed region set, and emits structured audit events for any policy decision that touches KMS-residency attributes.

Changes in this PR: (high level) - Enforce KMS region pinning in the RBAC v2 policy evaluator; policy check fails fast when a requested KMS key is out-of-region for the request's residency scope. - Emit structured audit logs for KMS-related decisions (decision, actor, resource_kms_key_id, requested_region, allowed_regions, reason, request_id). - Add feature flag (rbac_v2.kms_region_pinning.enforce) and a rollout plan (off by default, can be set to audit-only then enforce). - Add integration tests and unit tests covering the evaluator, migration helper, and audit sink. - Console: expose a read-only indicator for key residency mismatch in the resource details view. - Helm: add config toggle and default to audit-only for 30d ramp.

Checklist:
- [x] Implement evaluator changes and unit tests
- [x] Add structured audit events and sink wiring
- [x] Add migration helper and telemetry to monitor audit-only hits
- [x] Console indicator + docs
- [x] Helm chart config and default rollout policy
- [x] Integration tests against local KMS emulator
- [x] Security review and threat-model update (SEC-ENG reviewed)

Related Linear/Jira: [ENG-4521] [SEC-982] (see linked_linear and linked_jira fields). Related PRs: pr-623456-security-rbac-v2-kms-region-pinning-audit-hardening (follow-up).

Why not earlier? We previously had region hints in the KMS bindings but enforcement lived in downstream services. Centralizing enforcement in RBAC v2 ensures consistent behavior across Hosted/Dedicated/Private and avoids accidental key use across regions. Audit-only phase reduces risk during rollout.

Migration notes: The migration helper (scripts/migrations/2026-02-10-enforce-kms-pinning.py) will scan existing policies and emit a remediation suggestion file (remediation/kms_region_violations.json) and a small CLI to apply fixes. Operators should run in audit-only mode for two weeks and inspect top offenders via telemetry.

CI: unit + integration + e2e are included in checks. Integration initially flaked (timeout), re-run succeeded.

See changed files for details and small illustrative snippets.
